title: Add MCP with trust and recover auth
steps: Choose a supported transport. Current config is stdio; remote transport is offered only after capability negotiation.
Enter a bounded spec: name, command, args, environment references.
Review executable source, host, working directory and environment references; review trust.
Save; explicitly start the trusted server. A config file alone never starts an executable.
Observe health: stopped, connecting, ready, authentication required, failed or stale. Ready requires an observed handshake.
Inspect tool namespaces/schemas and set narrow permissions per server/tool.
complete_when: only discovered, healthy, enabled and authorized tools are offered to the correct task (p.184).
traceability: p.184; controls T-01..T-15; acceptance A21, A22, A23.
